syllabus_topics: ROBOTICS BLOCK Topic 1. Introduction to robotics
teaching_methods: Workshop/laboratory practices: Laboratory sessions where the theoretical contents of the subject will be put into practice. Specifically, two blocks of sessions will be carried out: the first block will correspond to content related to electronics: sensors, actuators, and microcontroller programming. In the second block, practices with a manipulator robot will be developed: inverse and forward kinematics and trajectories using a microcontroller.
Non-contact learning activities: Individual study and autonomous work on the contents of the subject.
Evaluation activities: Course questionnaires (see Evaluation section)
Theory: Development of the theoretical contents of the subject using the lecture technique.

assessment_methods.method: Expositions of exercises, topics, and works (development and presentation of a practical project)
